# AI Agent UI Gallery — Technical & Architecture Guide
> The premier open-source collection of 50+ modular, plug-and-play AI chatbot and agent UI components built for React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Overview
- **Name**: AI Agent UI Gallery
- **Developer**: Tech Pro / nealfrazier.tech
- **URL**: https://ai-agentui.757tech.pro/
- **Portfolio Showcase**: https://nealfrazier.tech
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion (Framer Motion v12), Vite 6, Lucide React, Syntax Highlighter.
- **LLM Integrations**: Google Gemini 2.5/3, OpenAI GPT-4o, Ollama local runtime, and built-in offline showcase fallback engine.

## Key Capabilities & Component Variants
The gallery contains 50 distinct component variants spanning 10 design aesthetics:
1. **Minimal**: Clean whitespace, subtle borders, high legibility.
2. **Glass**: Backdrop blur filters, translucent frosted glass overlays, glowing borders.
3. **Brutalist**: High-contrast black/white borders, hard drop shadows, bold typography.
4. **Playful**: Vibrant color palettes, soft rounded corners, animated badges.
5. **Neo-Tokyo**: Dark theme with neon cyan/magenta accents and futuristic glow.
6. **Corporate**: Professional enterprise design, structured layout.
7. **Dark Mode**: Deep slate `#020617` background with optimized contrast ratio.
8. **Gradient**: Smooth multi-stop background transitions.
9. **Retro**: Win95/classic computing aesthetic with inset borders.
10. **Cyberpunk**: Bold yellow/black accents, sharp corners, futuristic HUD elements.

## Agent Capabilities
- **Voice**: Real-time voice synthesis and acoustic modeling interface.
- **Vision**: Multi-modal image analysis, OCR, and object segmentation.
- **Files**: Document parsing, PDF analysis, and file attachment handlers.
- **Code**: Live syntax highlighting, code snippet copying, pair programming view.
- **Search**: Web search grounding, live index queries, citation display.
- **Translation**: Multi-language localization across 50+ languages.
- **Creative**: Generative art, copywriting, and ideation partner.

## React 19 & Tailwind v4 Integration Code

```tsx
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Sparkles, Send, Mic } from "lucide-react";

export function AgentWidget({ name = "AI Assistant" }) {
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([
    { role: "assistant", content: "Hello! How can I assist your workflow today?" }
  ]);

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (!input.trim()) return;
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: "user", content: input }]);
    setInput("");
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-4 text-white shadow-2xl">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-blue-600 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
            <Sparkles size={16} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-sm">{name}</span>
        </div>
        <span className="w-2 h-2 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full animate-ping" />
      </div>

      <div className="h-64 overflow-y-auto py-4 space-y-3">
        {messages.map((m, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={`flex ${m.role === "user" ? "justify-end" : "justify-start"}`}>
            <div className={`p-3 text-xs rounded-2xl max-w-[85%] ${m.role === "user" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white" : "bg-slate-800 text-slate-200"}`}>
              {m.content}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
        <input 
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && handleSend()}
          placeholder="Type a message..."
          className="flex-1 bg-slate-800/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
        />
        <button onClick={handleSend} className="p-2 bg-blue-600 rounded-xl hover:bg-blue-500 transition-all">
          <Send size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility (AX) Compliance
- WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant `:focus-visible` ring indicators.
- Skip navigation link (`#main-content`).
- Keyboard shortcuts: `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight` (variant cycle), `/` or `Ctrl+K` (search focus), `Esc` (modal close), `Alt+C` (toggle source code), `Alt+M` (mute/unmute sound).
- Dynamic ARIA live announcements for screen readers.
